top.warn.title: Scan results may be incomplete
chat.v.quickScanAsk: Which target? Type an IP address, or press the mic and say it, for example 192.168.1.1. I will ask you to confirm before anything is scanned, unless "Scan right away" is on.
chat.v.notSupported: This browser does not support voice commands. Please use Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge.
chat.v.notSecure: The microphone only works when this page is opened through localhost or HTTPS.
chat.v.listening: Listening… pause when done, or press the mic again
chat.v.pendingHint: Press the mic and say just the address (digit by digit is more accurate).
chat.v.digitTip: Digit by digit works best: "scan one nine two dot one six eight dot one dot one".
chat.v.guessedNote: I read the first word I heard as "scan". Please check the target before confirming.
chat.v.altNote: Used the speech engine's other reading. Please check the target before confirming.
chat.v.noSpeech: I did not hear anything. Press the mic and try again.
chat.v.blocked: The browser has blocked the microphone. Click the icon beside the URL and allow the microphone.
chat.v.noMic: No microphone was found on this computer.
chat.v.network: An internet connection is needed to turn speech into text.
chat.v.pdfOpened: Opened the PDF report for {j} in a new tab.
chat.v.pdfReady: The PDF report for {j} is ready. Use the button below to open it.
chat.v.exportFailed: Could not generate the {fmt} file for {j}. Please try again.
chat.v.serverError: Could not reach the server. Please try again.
chat.v.publicWarn: This is a public (internet) address. Make sure you are allowed to scan it.
chat.v.expired: The confirmation timed out. Please give the command again.
chat.v.tasks: Follow it on the Tasks page →
chat.v.autoTip: When on, the scan starts at once with no confirmation, only for an internal address (10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x) of /24 or smaller. Any other target still asks. You can stop the job from the Tasks page.
chat.v.autoRefused: Scan right away is on, but this target is not an internal address or is larger than /24, so it needs your confirmation.
chat.v.autoFailed: Could not save the Scan right away setting.
chat.v.stopGone: This job has already finished or been stopped.
chat.v.langAuto: Speaking language: Auto (listening for {l} now). Press to choose a language yourself
chat.v.langTh: Speaking language: Thai (press to switch to English)
chat.v.langEn: Speaking language: English (press to go back to Auto)
chat.v.micTitleWhisper: Voice command · local Whisper (press, then speak)
chat.v.tipAiOn: AI is on. Questions the system cannot answer itself are sent to the AI.
chat.v.tipAiOff: AI is off. I can only handle scan commands, opening pages and counting questions. Press ? to see what you can say.
chat.v.tipVoiceWhisper: Speech is turned into text by Whisper running on this machine. The audio is not sent to an outside service.
chat.v.tipVoiceBrowser: Speech is turned into text by the browser's own engine. The audio goes to the browser vendor and needs the internet.
chat.v.stTranscribeSub: The audio stays on this system
chat.v.stUnderstandSub: Checked by the system itself, no AI
chat.v.startTitle: Ask or give a command here
chat.v.startAiOn: Questions the system cannot answer itself are sent to the AI.
chat.v.startLimit: The AI sees every total, but only part of the device, vulnerability and scan lists. For details about one item, include its IP address or CVE ID in your question.
chat.v.startAiOff: Only scan commands, opening pages and questions about counts can be answered here. A superadministrator can switch the AI on in Settings.
chat.v.helpHint: Tap an example to try it. A scan example goes into the text box so you can change the address before sending.
chat.v.helpScanNote: A confirmation card comes first, unless "Scan right away" is on (internal addresses up to /24 only). Use an IPv4 address or a range such as 192.168.1.0/24 (no larger than /16).
chat.v.helpAskNote: Answered by the system itself from stored data, with no AI tokens.
chat.v.helpOpenNote: Jump directly to another page in the system, with no AI tokens.
chat.v.whisperDown: The local Whisper program is not running, so the browser's speech engine is used instead. Press the mic and speak again.
chat.v.whisperFailed: Whisper could not read that ({e}). Please try again, or type it.
chat.v.flipToEn: Auto mode: next time I will listen in English. Press the mic and say it again.
chat.v.flipToTh: Auto mode: next time I will listen in Thai. Press the mic and say it again.
chat.v.inputPlaceholderPage: Type a message, or press the microphone and speak
chat.v.aiConnectFail: Could not reach the AI. Please try again.
chat.v.promptScanHelp:
Type the target you want to scan, for example:
"scan 192.168.1.1"
"scan 10.0.0.0/24 intense"
"scan 192.168.1.1 for vulnerabilities"
chat.v.greetA: CLYLAR Assistant can answer questions about your system data, such as devices, ports and the vulnerabilities found.
chat.v.greetB: You can start a scan by typing or speaking. It asks you to confirm first, unless "Scan right away" is on.
chat.v.histEmpty2: Start a chat and it is saved automatically
chat.v.histNoMatchHint: Try an IP, a scan type or another keyword
chat.v.helpTip1: Saying the IP address digit by digit is more accurate.
chat.v.helpTip2: Say just "scan" and you will be asked which target.
chat.v.helpTip3: Speak or type in Thai or English.
chat.v.helpTip4: Anything else needs the AI switched on in Settings.
chat.v.helpHideNote: You can hide the floating button and shortcuts in Settings.
chat.hint.title: You can hide this button
chat.hint.body: If you do not need the floating button and shortcuts, you can hide them in Settings.
notice.see_tasks: See it on the Tasks page
dash.subtitle: Network scan overview
dash.kpi.cve_tip: Open ports the vulnerability scans checked: {services}. Evaluated: {evaluated} (CVEs found: {found} · none found: {none}). Not evaluated: {not_evaluated} (see the reasons on the Vulnerabilities page).
dash.top_ports.sub: Top {n} found on the most devices
dash.more_devices: Show {n} more devices in the Open Ports window
dash.port_on_devices: This port is open on {n} devices across all scans
dash.os.view_unknown: View devices with no OS result yet
dash.os.note: The OS is a guess by nmap · Unknown = no OS result from a scan yet
dash.changes.title: Changes Since the Previous Scan
dash.changes.none: No changes since the previous scan
dash.changes.new_kev: {n} new CVEs that CISA lists as exploited in the wild
dash.changes.empty: There is no repeated scan to compare yet. Scan the same target with the same scan type again (or schedule a daily scan) and new devices, changed ports and new CVEs will show here.
dash.th.name: Scan name
dash.port_not_open: This port is not open (the state nmap reported)
dash.js.tierClean: No vulnerabilities found (passed a Vulnerability scan)
dash.js.bannerCH: {n} devices have Critical/High vulnerabilities. Fix them soon.
dash.js.bannerClean: Most devices were scanned for vulnerabilities and no problem was found
dash.js.bannerUnscanned: Most devices have not been scanned for vulnerabilities yet (Vulnerability Scan)
dash.js.portsSub: Top ports found most often across all scans
dash.js.portsNote: Unique ports (not counted twice) from all scans. Click a row to see its devices.
dash.js.cveNone: ✓ No CVEs found in the latest scan
dash.js.cveSub: Vulnerabilities found in the latest scan
dash.js.kevLine: CISA says this vulnerability is exploited in the wild
dash.js.cveNoDesc: No description in the saved data
login.heading: Welcome back
login.sub: Sign in to CLYLAR Network Scanner
ui.settings.card_note: Applies to your account and is remembered on every device you sign in on
ui.settings.theme_help: Light is the default. The dark theme is easier on the eyes in dim light.
ui.settings.lang_help: Includes notices from the system. The PDF report is always in Thai.
chat.vp_type: Type a command instead of speaking
chat.vp_input_ph: Type a command, for example: how many devices
chat.clear_q: Clear this chat? What you typed stays in the History tab, but messages from voice commands are lost.
chat.qr.ips_q: List all the IP addresses found
chat.qr.latest_q: What were the results of the latest scan?
adv.excl.pn_with_pr: Cannot be used together with skipping the ping check (-Pn)
adv.excl.pr_with_pn: Cannot be used together with finding devices that ignore ping
adv.excl.ap_with_gt: Cannot be used together with the Gentle scan (too slow for 65,535 ports)
adv.excl.gt_with_ap: Cannot be used together with scanning all ports (too slow for 65,535 ports)
adv.excl.udp_gentle: Top 1,000 cannot be used with the gentle scan
adv.excl.udp_timing: Top 100 and Top 1,000 cannot be used with timing T1
adv.timing.by_gentle: Set by the Gentle scan mode (T2)
adv.ap.over: {n} addresses is above the limit of {max} addresses (a /26). The system will not accept this scan. Please narrow the target range or turn this option off.
adv.ap.est: {n} addresses × 65,535 ports · roughly {lo} to {hi} if devices answer normally, and up to {worst} if a firewall drops the probes
adv.ap.long: · may take several hours and use 1 of the 2 scan slots
adv.ap.vuln: · and looks up CVEs for every open port
chat.v.tipAiOnLocal: AI is on. Questions the system cannot answer itself go to the local model on the computer that runs the app, and nothing is sent outside it.
chat.v.stAskSubLocal: Runs on the computer that runs the app; may be slower
chat.v.answerLost: No answer arrived for this question because answering was interrupted or did not finish.
